entities.summary: The Agricultural University of Kraków, located in Kraków, Poland, became a university by decree of the Council of Ministers as of 28 September 1972. Formerly, it was known as the Higher College of Agriculture, as well as other names, since its establishment in 1890. The university is named after the prominent Polish constitutional reformer and educationalist Hugo Kołłątaj.
